question: Identify the state of India in which the Bandipur National Park is located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bandipur National Park** is located in the state of **Karnataka, India**
 
• The park was established in 1974 as a tiger reserve under Project Tiger.
 
• It is situated in the Chamarajanagar district and is part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve,
 
 
• which includes other protected areas like Nagarhole National Park and Mudumalai National Park.
 
 
 
• Bandipur National Park is known for its rich biodiversity, including a variety of flora and fauna, such as tigers, elephants, leopards, and several species of birds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some national Parks of Karnataka
 
• Nagarhole National Park (Rajiv Gandhi National Park)
 
 
• Location: Kodagu and Chamarajanagar districts.
 
• Established: 1983.
 
• A significant tiger reserve, Nagarhole is known for its healthy population of elephants, leopards, and various species of birds.
 
 
 
• Kudremukh National Park
 
 
• Location: Chikmagalur district.
 
• Established: 1987.
 
• It is Known for its lush green mountains and rich biodiversity, including several endemic species of flora and fauna.
 
• The park derives its name from Kudremukh peak, which resembles a horse's face.
